messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

Refunds cannot be sent to a new card, even if the original card was cancelled. The refund must go to the original payment; your card issuer handles the credit, and the shop cannot promise where or when it appears (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Would you like to proceed with a refund to the original payment?
